What does real-time transcription look like in a live setting?

🎙 We used Voxtral Transcribe 3 at AI Engineer Paris to capture every main-stage talk in real time. We boosted accuracy with context biasing, feeding the model speaker names and technical terms from the conference https://t.co/L2mxmjrlav

Switch from Claude Code to Codex, Cursor or your own harness, and Nex-N2.6 still calls only the tools that are actually there. The open-weight 321B multimodal agentic model from Nex-AGI is built on GLM-5.3-Flash for computer use, coding and long-horizon tasks. 📜 Apache 2.0 🤖 https://t.co/5JKFLqdBxN

For the first time, AI has mathematically proven @signalapp’s protocol is secure down to the code level.

Using our breakthrough AlphaProof Code framework, we verified the messaging app’s cryptographic system – which protects billions of private messages every day. https://t.co/iWNJ8UiTSQ

Sophon-Realtime v1.1 from Adventists AI @BKJinAI adds zero-shot voice cloning to an open-weights, full-duplex voice model.

Drop a few seconds of someone's voice into model/voices/, set "voice" to its name, and talk to it in that voice in real time. No fine-tuning, no restart, https://t.co/11v4Q6O41O

MiniMax H3 × @HeyGen 🎬

Let your AI agent direct. Make your best cinematic shot through the HeyGen MCP with HeyGen Video 1, which is built on MiniMax H3, and win $5K in MiniMax API credits.

Post with #HeyGenVideoContest by Dec 1 👇

https://t.co/Kds7nEIJPk https://t.co/51OSc6xcaV

Huge thanks to @runware for Day 0 support of MiniMax H3 Image 💚  

MiniMax H3 Image: 16 references in, 2–3x faster out. Built for ad creative, e-commerce, and content at scale. 

 #H3Image https://t.co/NRoN6ClAN0

MiniMax H3 Image × @fal 🚀

4K images in ~10 seconds. Follows complex prompts, edits with precision, and handles game and 3D assets with ease. Fast enough to power agents and productivity tools, not just image apps.

Thanks fal team, always a pleasure building with you.

#H3Image https://t.co/03Rd5pwV2m

Deeper knowledge. Richer world understanding. Stronger coding and agentic capabilities.

Built for real-world tasks — from complex coding and knowledge work to front-end builds and professional software workflows.

Qwen4-Max is now in preview on Alibaba’s Token Plan. You can also get early access to the new model on QwenWork, Qoder, Qwen APP, and QwenStudio.

Put it to the test on a real problem. Show us what you build.

已报且不要再收：Gemini 4 Carbon、Canva Craft、Claude Fable 5.2、Claude Mythos 5.2、Muse Ember、Control Room、Sophon-Realtime v1、Voxtral 3 Transcribe 实时转写演示、Hy4，以及 already_reported_names 全部。

Qwen4 / Qwen4-Max：@Alibaba_Qwen 官方帖全文确认——Qwen4 is coming；Qwen4-Max is now in preview on Alibaba’s Token Plan，也可在 QwenWork、Qoder、Qwen APP、QwenStudio 获得 early access。能力描述仅限帖内：Deeper knowledge、richer world understanding、stronger coding and agentic capabilities，以及 complex coding、knowledge work、front-end builds、professional software workflows。这是官方首次预览，可按模型收录。互动数据（get_posts_by_id）：views=833554，bookmarks=1250，likes=10029。建站热词可用完整名 Qwen4-Max（不要用单独的 Qwen4 通用词如果指代不清；优先完整产品名）。Token Plan 链接：http://qwencloud.com/pricing/token-plan 。不要编造参数、上下文长度或与前代对比。
AlphaProof Code：@GoogleDeepMind 官方称首次用 AlphaProof Code framework 在代码层面数学证明 @signalapp 协议安全。这是科研成果/框架，不是新的通用大模型，若收须 kind=not_model，desc 末尾加「不是新模型」。

Sophon-Realtime v1 已于 2026-11-09 收录。本窗 @ModelScope2022 介绍 Sophon-Realtime v1.1（Adventists AI / @BKJinAI）为开源权重全双工语音模型新增 zero-shot voice cloning：把几秒声音放入 model/voices/ 即可实时用该声音对话，无需微调或重启。可按功能更新收，kind=not_model，不要写成全新模型家族。

Nex-N2.6：@ModelScope2022 介绍来自 Nex-AGI 的开源权重 321B 多模态智能体模型，基于 GLM-5.3-Flash，用于 computer use、编程与长程任务，Apache-2.0；并称从 Claude Code 换到 Codex/Cursor/自建 harness 时仍只调用实际存在的工具。帖文未明确写“今日首发”。本名单尚未收录该名字；若收，来源用此官方关注账号帖，first_seen 用该帖时间，不得编造未写出的规格。
Voxtral Transcribe 3 在 AI Engineer Paris 的实时转写演示是已报产品的使用案例，不收。
MiniMax H3 Image 与 fal、runware 的合作上架，以及 MiniMax H3 × HeyGen 的视频比赛（提及 HeyGen Video 1 built on MiniMax H3）都是已报模型的合作/营销；HeyGen Video 1 无 HeyGen 官方首发帖，按传闻不收。
